steps.title: Identity crawl
steps.body: Users are bulk-indexed first. If groups are returned, memberships must be too, or the SDK raises InconsistentDataError.

steps.title: Resolve since
steps.body: On an incremental crawl, the SDK calls _get_last_crawl_timestamp(). The base implementation returns None.

steps.title: Fetch and transform
steps.body: Your data client's get_source_data(), then your transform().

steps.title: Upload
steps.body: Full: bulk_index_documents() for replacement and stale cleanup. Incremental: additive index_documents().

steps.title: Exit
steps.body: On exception, the error counter increments and the error is re-raised, so a scheduler sees a non-zero exit.
